headline: Tempest Island and KingsCage Join Fishermans Row Fray
war_summary: Since the previous edition, Fishermans Row has remained the busiest sector, logging seven strategic-base actions in the last two hours and eighteen in a day, with fighting still hot at the cutoff. Linn Mercy, while quieter than before, still recorded two actions in two hours and eight in six, its day count holding at twenty-nine. New flare-ups have appeared on Tempest Island and in KingsCage, each with three actions in two hours and latest events at the cutoff or shortly before. Stlican Shelf also remains active, with two actions in the latest two hours and a further event at the cutoff. Stonecradle has gone quiet in the immediate hours but still shows five actions in six hours and twelve in a day. DeadLands, Endless Shore, Marban Hollow, Farranac Coast, Oarbreaker, and Stema Landing have all fallen still in the latest six hours. Weathered Expanse continues to bleed heavily—over fifteen thousand Colonial and fourteen thousand Warden casualties in a day—yet reports no base actions.
